title: Tim Dooley Equation and Formalism Ledger
purpose: Recover, classify and integrate equations, coordinate systems, geometries and scientific analogies used across the Tim Dooley / Potato of Life project. The ledger now records equation role, variables, units/dimensions, model family and measurement status so formulas become parts of a scientific architecture rather than an undated pile.

integration_rules: Historical formulas are never silently corrected; create descendant entries for technical repairs.
Equations from different domains cannot be algebraically combined unless their variables and units are mapped.

Every fitted numerical constant must say whether it was measured, assumed, derived or optimized.
